mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_roi_history (rh_dv_id, rh_action, rh_roi_json, rh_meta_json, rh_roi_hash, rh_base_hash, rh_status, rh_u_name) VALUES (#{dvId}, #{action}, #{roiJson}, #{metaJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{roiHash}, #{baseHash,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'PENDING', #{uName})

INSERT INTO tbl_roi_history (rh_dv_id, rh_action, rh_roi_json, rh_meta_json, rh_roi_hash, rh_base_hash, rh_status, rh_u_name, rh_resp_date) VALUES (#{dvId}, 'SYNC', #{roiJson}, #{metaJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{roiHash}, NULL, 'SUCCESS', 'SYSTEM', now())
mapper.select: SELECT rh_id, rh_roi_hash, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, rh_req_date, now()) AS age_min FROM tbl_roi_history WHERE rh_dv_id = #{dvId} AND rh_status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY rh_id
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_roi_history SET rh_status = #{status}, rh_fail_code = #{failCode,jdbcType=INTEGER}, rh_fail_msg = #{failMsg,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, rh_resp_date = now() WHERE rh_id = #{rhId} AND rh_status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tbl_roi_history WHERE rh_dv_id = #{dvId} AND rh_status = 'SUCCESS'
SELECT rh_id, rh_action, rh_roi_json, rh_meta_json, rh_roi_hash FROM tbl_roi_history WHERE rh_dv_id = #{dvId} AND rh_status = 'SUCCESS' ORDER BY rh_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT rh_id, rh_dv_id, rh_action, rh_roi_json, rh_meta_json, rh_roi_hash, rh_base_hash, rh_status, rh_fail_code, rh_fail_msg, rh_u_name, DATE_FORMAT(rh_req_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS req_date, DATE_FORMAT(rh_resp_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS resp_date FROM tbl_roi_history WHERE rh_id = #{rhId}

SELECT h.rh_id, h.rh_action, h.rh_status, h.rh_fail_code, h.rh_fail_msg, h.rh_u_name, LEFT(h.rh_roi_hash, 12) AS hash_short, DATE_FORMAT(h.rh_req_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS req_date, DATE_FORMAT(h.rh_resp_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS resp_date, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tbl_roi_snapshot s WHERE s.rs_rh_id = h.rh_id) AS snapshot_count FROM tbl_roi_history h WHERE h.rh_dv_id = #{dvId} ORDER BY h.rh_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_roi_snapshot (rs_rh_id, rs_camera, rs_file_path, rs_width, rs_height) VALUES (#{rhId}, #{camera}, #{filePath}, #{width}, #{height})
mapper.select: SELECT rs_id, rs_camera, rs_width, rs_height FROM tbl_roi_snapshot WHERE rs_rh_id = #{rhId} ORDER BY rs_camera
